gates.horizon_basis: 24 non-overlapping daily sessions, 1h bars resampled 24h, BTC/USDT; vol target 10% annualised (sqrt(365)), cap 1.0
gates.retirement_reason: |gap| is direction-blind: a de-risked overlay always diverges from buy-and-hold when the asset trends (gives up upside in rallies, loses less in crashes), so the predicate measures the asset move, not overlay quality. The committed code also used hourly-sampled overlapping returns (~2 days, not 24 sessions) and annualised daily vol by 24*sqrt(365) instead of sqrt(365), shrinking scale ~24x and inflating the gap.
gates.diagnostic_note: signed_effect is report-only (framework 2c: report, do not wire). Positive = vol-target beat buy-and-hold net; negative = it lagged. Window-dependent by construction.
gates.evidence: over 24 non-overlapping daily sessions: buy-and-hold -104.432 bp/day vs vol-targeted -29.800 bp/day (mean exposure 0.198); signed effect +74.631 bp/day. The |gap| KILL rule is retired as ILL-POSED (it measures the asset move, not the overlay).
